description: Cancel a booking this connection made, for the customer, under HomeMaster's usual rules. Two calls. (1) Send reference (the hmb_ or hmr_ request_booking returned) and the customer's phone; for one visit of a weekly or every-2-weeks plan add visit_date, without it the whole booking is cancelled. The answer (outcome confirm_needed) says what will be cancelled, the fee, the refund and why, with a confirm_code; nothing changes. Tell the customer all of it and get their yes. (2) Call again with the same fields, confirm_code and customer_confirmed: true; the answer (outcome cancelled) says what was refunded or kept. Other outcomes say why nothing changed and what to do: refused (for a booking not made on this connection, a paid booking still waiting for an expert, or a visit under 2 hours away, the customer manages it on My Bookings or with HomeMaster on WhatsApp). A repeat of a used code returns the first answer, never a second cancel.

confirm_code.description: Second call only: the confirm_code the first call returned. Good for 15 minutes.

customer_confirmed.description: Second call only: true when the customer heard the change, its cost and why, and said yes.

phone.description: The customer's number, as they booked with it, e.g. 9123 4567. It must match the booking.

reference.description: The reference request_booking returned for this booking (starts with hmb_ or hmr_).

visit_date.description: Optional: the date of the one visit to cancel, YYYY-MM-DD, from booking_status. Without it, the whole booking.

name: cancel_booking
title: Cancel a booking
